macro.headline: Bull regime intact but momentum cracking — defensive rotation under a calm surface
macro.story:
The tape is split. Price-wise, SPY and QQQ are still above both their 50-day and 200-day moving averages and the broader regime reads as a bull market — SPY is just 1.7% off its 52-week high. But under the hood, momentum has rolled: MACD is below signal on SPY, QQQ, and the Nasdaq composite; all three indexes sit in the lower half of their Bollinger ranges; and the 5-day and 21-day changes are negative across major indexes ex-Dow and Russell. The Dow and Russell 2000 are the relative leaders — a classic defensive/value rotation footprint.

The cross-asset picture confirms the rotation story. The VIX jumped roughly 21% over the past five days to 19.8, sitting above both its 50- and 200-day averages with bullish MACD — fear is repricing higher even though it hasn't broken into panic territory. The dollar (DXY) is in a clean uptrend with RSI of 68 (overbought-leaning), and on cue both gold (-3.9% in 5 days, RSI 35) and silver (-11.7% in 5 days, RSI 29) are getting hit — the validated DXY-strength-into-metals-weakness inverse relationship is firing. WTI crude has cratered roughly 21% over 21 days into oversold territory (RSI 27.6) while natural gas quietly grinds higher.

The most plausible driver grounded in the active themes is the Geopolitical Risk Unwind (Iran deal / Hormuz reopening, conviction 6). That theme directly explains the crude collapse and the energy-sector weakness, and it's risk-positive on net (lower inflation pressure, eases Fed path). At the same time, the AI Infrastructure capex cycle is in CHASING stage — concentrated, narrow leadership in mega-cap tech — which explains why broad tech is only neutral while a handful of names extend. The defensive bid into Healthcare, Utilities, and Industrials suggests risk appetite is narrowing even as the headline indexes hold up.

Net: this is a transitional zone — not washed out, not euphoric, no validated market-timing signal active. Engine C reads CALM (RSI 47, SPY 7% above 200-day, breadth healthy). Long-only posture should favor the validated rotation winners (Healthcare, Industrials, Financials, select Capital Markets and Credit Services) and avoid chasing the broken Energy/Discretionary/Communication groups. Confidence is LOW because price-above-SMAs conflicts with bearish MACD, spiking VIX, and a defensive rotation pattern.

DXY at 101.22 is riding above both its 21- and 50-day SMAs with RSI 66, and the ACTIVE DXY_METALS_TAG signal is doing exactly what the backtest says it should: Gold -8.7% over 21 days, Silver -21.3%, Copper -2.2%, Oil -21.4%. Every other narrative this week — the precious-metals fade, the commodity reflation unwind, even the rotation into domestic cyclicals — is a downstream effect of a firm dollar.

**[CROSS-ASSET LENS]** The regime tape is CHOPPY at 4/10 confidence with SPY -1.9% on the month but still +5.1% over its 200SMA and breadth at 72.7% above 50SMA — a market that is digesting, not breaking. VIX at 19.9 is up 24% on the month but term structure stays flat (VIX3M 19.57), so this is a positioning wobble, not a stress event. The 2Y yield is pinned at 3.67 with RSI 73.9 (trending, not toppy — we don't fade that), while 10Y at 4.40 has eased to RSI 42; per the backtest we treat this as trend, not a ceiling. TLT at RSI 65 and above its upper band is in an uptrend — again, no mean-reversion edge to lean on. Oil at RSI 27.5 is oversold but the WTI backtest is explicit: oversold has kept falling, so it stays a trend read.

**[SECTOR & ROTATION LENS]** Leadership has rotated hard into domestic cyclicals and defensives that benefit from a firm dollar and stable rates: XLI +5.9%, XLV +5.3%, XLF +3.5%, IWM +3.1% on the month, with XLK -0.2% and QQQ -1.8% lagging despite XLK's ACCELERATING_BULLISH trajectory above its 50SMA. Industrials and Financials leading with Tech digesting is a textbook strong-dollar, firm-front-end rotation.

**[WHERE THE OPPORTUNITY IS]** Semiconductors are the clearest "already run" — HOT 13 months, +258% (matches the all-time max on record), flagged CEILING; that is exits-not-entries territory regardless of how strong the AI Infrastructure theme reads (CHASING, day 25, health 8). Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (HOT 5 months, +46% vs +5% typical) is mid-spell and worth respecting but no longer early.

**[WHAT TO WATCH]** The tripwire is DXY 99.38 — the listed support. As long as the dollar holds above it, the precious-metals fade, the commodity-reflation unwind, and the rotation away from mega-cap tech into domestic cyclicals all stay intact. A clean break below 99.38 would reopen Gold, Silver, Copper, and the broader reflation trade; until then, treat any bounce in Silver (-21% in 21 days, RSI 29) or Oil (RSI 27.5) as a washout that statistically gets retested within 60 days, not a low that is in.
